title: French or Catalina Dressing, Fat Free

content.title: About
content.content: French and Catalina fat‑free dressings are low‑calorie sauces made from tomato puree, vinegar, spices and aromatic herbs. They contain no added oil, making them suitable for low‑fat diets.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Both dressings are popular in the United States as alternatives to traditional mayo‑based sauces.
Catalina dressing often includes pineapple juice, giving it a sweet‑tart flavor.
French dressing is typically enriched with mustard and herbs such as oregano and basil.
The fat‑free version reduces calories to about 15–20 kcal per 100 ml.
These sauces are commonly used on salads, as marinades, and as dips.

items.title: Low calorie
items.content: The absence of fat makes the dressing suitable for weight‑management.

items.title: Source of vitamin C
items.content: Tomato juice and vinegar provide vitamin C, which supports the immune system.

items.title: Antioxidants
items.content: Lycopene from tomatoes offers antioxidant protection.

items.title: Digestive aid
items.content: Vinegar stimulates gastric juice production, aiding digestion.

items.title: Reduced sodium
items.content: Fat‑free versions typically contain less salt than traditional sauces.

items.title: Allergy to ingredients
items.content: Some formulations may contain mustard, soy sauce or pineapple, which can trigger allergies.

items.title: Acidity
items.content: The high acidity of vinegar may irritate the stomach in people with gastritis.

items.title: Sugar content
items.content: Catalina dressing is sometimes sweetened, which may be a concern for diabetics.

content.title: How to Use
content.content: Drizzle over salads, use as a marinade for chicken or fish, serve with vegetable sticks, or as a dip for appetizers. Pairs well with leafy greens, grilled vegetables and seafood.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep refrigerated after opening in a tightly sealed bottle. Once opened, it is best used within 1–2 weeks. Discard if the smell, color or taste changes.
